summary: Prepare a mission, publish private materials, play with Mia and build grounded learning insights.
scope: A first-party walkthrough adapted from the ClassGame architecture generator and mission sequence guides. Workflows are packages inside one Go module, not independent microservices. Optional background jobs default off; this is not a claim of a hosted deployment. This example uses Vertex AI for Gemini inference; the Gemini API is an alternative.
author: Thoth

componentNotes.client: The browser handles teacher and student interactions and streams draft progress.
componentNotes.api: The Go API authorizes requests and invokes the relevant in-process workflow.
componentNotes.mission: Builds and validates a draft before publishing a pinned mission revision.
componentNotes.tutor: Uses the pinned mission and the current attempt to return grounded feedback.
componentNotes.learning: Builds learning summaries from validated, bounded evidence.
componentNotes.policy: Limits prompt context and keeps model calls behind a provider boundary.
componentNotes.vertex: Provides the managed inference endpoint used to call Gemini.
componentNotes.model: Generates structured questions, feedback and summaries from bounded context.
componentNotes.db: Stores durable mission revisions, attempt evidence and generation results.
componentNotes.broker: Queues optional background work independently of synchronous learning requests.
componentNotes.worker: Reuses the Go workflows to process queued work with version checks.
componentNotes.upload: Receives temporary files while a teacher prepares a mission.
componentNotes.storage: Keeps validated published files behind private access.
componentNotes.outbox: Keeps pending answers on the device until the API accepts them.
componentNotes.limits: Keeps concurrent AI usage within shared admission limits.
